notes.title: A tower defense spin-off: Candy Factory TD!
notes.content:
Wishlist the tower defense spin-off: Candy Factory TD!
Imagine Chocolate Factory x Bloons TD, and Chocolate Factory owners will get a major discount for this!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072370/Candy_Factory_TD/
A DEMO for it is available NOW! Try it and let me know what you think! (Discord)

There will also be a prologue soon which will include more content than the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080710/Candy_Factory_TD_Prologue/

notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.content:
Hotfix 4
- Adjusted Extractor T2 and T3 to output items faster to keep up with T2/T3 conveyor belts better.
- Fixed Castle Foundations snapping to each other has another incorrect snapping point.
- Added a snapping point for Castle Gates to Castle Foundations.
- Increased max building distance for castle structures.

You can join our Discord or make a Steam discussion post to leave feedback. I read all your comments.
Also please leave a Steam review to help the game reach more players.
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.content:
Hotfix 3
- Fixed the Ceiling snapping point on the outer side of Walls is wrongly positioned.
- Fixed Extractor T2/T3 inventory recipe shows the wrong crafting speed.
- Widescreen only: fixed an issue with items disappearing on the sides of screen.

You can join our Discord or make a Steam discussion post to leave feedback. I read all your comments.
Also please leave a Steam review to help the game reach more players.
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Hotfix 2
- Sort button now also merges splitted stacks of items.
- Fixed an issue with the Extractor bounding box.
- Added a snapping point on the bottom of Stairs for Foundations.
- Fixed an issue where unconnected power cables caused by removing the power hub would cause an annoying message.

You can join our Discord or make a Steam discussion post to leave feedback. I read all your comments.
Also please leave a Steam review to help the game reach more players.
Thanks for playing!

Known issues:
- Widescreen only issue with items disappearing on the sides of screen - being worked on, will be fixed hopefully tomorrow.

notes.title: Chocolate Factory Is Now Available!
notes.content:
If you have any feedback or suggestions you can post them on the Steam discussions or on our Discord.
Please help support the game by leaving an early Steam review after playing a bit. Those help a lot!
And don't forget to send the game to a friend!

I hope you enjoy the game as much as I'v enjoyed making and playing through it!

Buy here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2854710/Chocolate_Factory/

Changes from the demo/prologue:
- Added vertical stacking of smelters/farms.
- Added conveyor belt snapping to Wall Windows.
- If you have a weak PC, the game should now run a lot better (better FPS), just be sure to set View Distance to Medium/Low.
- Added the ability to assign structures to the hotbar (open the build menu for instructions at the top).
- Pressing X to destroy a structure now activates build mode instead of telling you to activate build mode.
- Other UI improvements.
- Other fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Low-End Optimization Update
notes.content:
Hi, an optimization update is out for the demo/prologue:
If you have a weak PC, the game should now run a lot better (better FPS), just be sure to set View Distance to Medium/Low.
